theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_irp_minpoly_roots
theorems.statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] (α : E), IsIntegral ℤ α → ∃ (n : ℕ) (β : Fin n → E), Function.Injective β ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, IsIntegral ℤ (β i)) ∧ (∀ σ : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E, ∃ i : Fin n, β i = σ α) ∧ (minpoly ℤ α).map (Int.castRingHom E) = Finset.univ.prod (fun i : Fin n => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (β i))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
